## 2. Interpretation decisions

| Topic | Decision |
|---|---|
| Statuses | Supported set = **Draft, Planned, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled**. Draft/In Progress/Completed are the mandatory ones from the specification; Planned and Cancelled come from the workbook. **Planned is NOT treated as Draft and Cancelled is kept as its own status.** No seed record uses Draft (it is created through the UI). All transitions between all statuses are allowed; every transition to Completed is validated by F06. |
| Results | Supported: Passed, Failed, Not evaluated (spec) plus Conditionally passed, Passed with remarks, Preliminary, Cancelled (workbook). An **empty** result in the source (16 records) is stored as NULL and is *not* silently converted to "Not evaluated". Only Passed/Failed satisfy F06. |
| Test date | Source holds ISO calendar weeks `KTww/yy`. Stored as `test_year` + `test_week`; `test_date` stays NULL (no dates invented). `period_start`/`period_end` = Monday/Sunday of that ISO week; a From–To filter matches records whose period **overlaps** the range. |
| Responsible person | Stored as text (as in the workbook). 17 records name a person whose user role is *Reader*; that is legitimate (responsible person ≠ editor of the record) and unchanged. |
| Attachments | Workbook contains path strings only. 39 references (39 distinct files: {"pdf":28,"csv":11}) become `attachment` rows flagged `synthetic = TRUE`; clearly labelled placeholder files are generated at start-up. `uploaded_by` = `seed-import`, `uploaded_at` = record Created at (workbook has no per-attachment audit). |
| Created/Modified | Taken from the workbook (e-mail + local time, Europe/Prague → timestamptz). |
| Test types | IDs TT01–TT11 map to ids 1–11 (displayed as TT01…). |

## 3. Data inconsistencies

### 3.1 README claim vs. actual data (Completed rule)

The workbook README states that *"all 50 main records are consistent with the Completed rule"*. **This is not true.** 28 records are Completed; only 15 have result Passed/Failed. **13 Completed records** have a result that the official F06 rule does not accept (Conditionally passed / Passed with remarks). All 28 Completed records do have ≥1 attachment reference.

These 13 records are **legacy/demo-data exceptions**. They are imported unchanged, the F06 rule is **not weakened**: it is enforced for every new transition to Completed (and when the result of a Completed record is changed). Editing e.g. only the comment of a legacy record is still possible; attempting to move it Completed → Draft → Completed, or to keep Completed while changing the result to another non-Passed/Failed value, is rejected.
